detailed_descriptions.en: The horrors awaken. The gates have opened. The rules are simple: escape… or stay forever. ◈ ◈ Exploring a haunted manor quickly turns into a twisted game of survival. Split apart by walls but connected by voice, you’ll have to rely on each other if you want to see the outside again. ◈ ◈ You’ll never see the full picture alone. Half the clues are yours, the rest belong to your partner. Share what you see and guide each other through the unknown… and be careful what else might be listening. Built-in 3D voice chat keeps you connected. PLEASE NOTE: This escape can only be played in co-op. Each player needs their own device and game copy. ◈ ◈ And it’s not your partner keeping you company. ◈ ◈ Private lobbies for friends, public lobbies for strangers, either way, you’ll be inside the manor in moments. Getting out? That’s the hard part. Features Horror-themed atmosphere Online co-op: 2 players only Two perspectives Built-in 3D voice chat with character voice lines Communication-driven puzzles 15 challenges Multiple endings ◈ ◈ Buy now and enter the twisted game.
